perplexity.description:
Can't Lose My (Soul) is the debut studio album by Annie & The Caldwells, released on March 21, 2025, by Luaka Bop. Hailing from West Point, Mississippi, the group blends gospel, soul, funk, and disco into a vibrant sound that reflects their family roots and spiritual heritage. Recorded at the Message Center in West Point and produced by Sinkane, the album features six tracks that center on themes of spiritual struggle, redemption, and grace. The music is marked by Annie Caldwell’s soaring vocals, supported by her family’s harmonies and Willie Joe Caldwell Sr.’s psychedelic guitar riffs, creating a sound that is both uplifting and deeply rooted in Southern gospel tradition.

As the group’s first full-length release, Can't Lose My (Soul) establishes Annie & The Caldwells as a distinctive voice in contemporary soul and gospel music. Critics praised the album for its immediacy and emotional resonance, with AllMusic calling it a “shining addition to the Caldwells' legacy,” and The Guardian highlighting its vivid, urgent production. The album’s blend of gospel fervor, soulful melodies, and disco rhythms has earned acclaim for its authenticity and energy, positioning it as a standout debut in the 2025 soul and funk landscape.
